name: VEFdocsKit
author: V-IMAGES.com / éric Fabre

sections.description:
VEFdocsKit gives the people you choose a page on your site where they drop their documents and get them back ready to use: images and text files turned into PDF files, and twelve tools to work on the pages, with a “My documents” tab where each person keeps the results worth keeping. It is made for any activity that files documents: law firms, accountants, associations, public bodies, anyone who has to put documents in order.

Try it before installing: the live demo lets you try the tools online with sample files; the Pro features are shown there too.

Everything happens on your own server. The PDF files are read and written by the plugin itself, in plain PHP: there is no program to install on the server and no document is ever sent to another service.

Why VEFdocsKit

  • One page for your users, with their own accounts that never open your administration, and documents that each account alone can see.
  • Nothing to install on the server: no external program, no online service.
  • A journal of every document handled: date, person, document, action and pages, with the file to download while it is kept. The SHA-256 fingerprint of the file received and of the file returned is recorded with each line.
  • Works in the block editor, in Divi 5 and in Elementor, with the same choices in all three.
  • The page takes the look of your site (font, colors, corners) unless you set its own style.
  • No tracking: nothing is collected, and nothing is sent unless you yourself send a support request or choose the optional free license.

Protected PDF files

  • The free plugin can lock a PDF with a password (the Protect tool). It works on PDF files that are not protected: a protected file (restrictions on editing, copying or printing, or a password to open it) is refused with a clear message.
  • Opening protected PDF files, including the extracts that come from administrations and company registers, is a feature of the paid extension VEFdocsKit Pro. It detects the protection on its own, in every tool, and a short message tells you when it was removed.

My documents

  • Every result can be kept in “My documents”: a private space, encrypted like the rest, where each account finds its documents again, downloads them, deletes them, or sends them back into any tool without downloading and uploading again.
  • A warning and a confirmation come before keeping a document, so nobody keeps one by mistake. The limits are yours: number of documents, room per person and number of days (Settings).
  • VEFdocsKit Pro adds the deposit of files waiting to be processed, folders inside folders, the choice of several documents at once and a disk quota per person. If the license of the Pro ends, the simple list stays: documents can still be downloaded, used and deleted.

Turn images and text into PDF

  • JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF and BMP images become PDF pages, one image per page, centered on an A4 page. You choose whether a picture is kept at its size, fitted to the page or given a page of its own size.
  • Text files (.txt) become A4 pages of text, in the font you choose: sans-serif, serif or typewriter (every character the same width, so columns stay aligned).

Twelve tools for the pages

  • Merge several documents into one, with an index of the documents in front, a separator page before each one and bookmarks.
  • Split a document by groups of pages or every few pages.
  • Keep, delete or reorder pages, and rotate them. Pages are typed like 1-3, 5, 8- (8- means page 8 to the end). To reorder, you can also drag the pages with the mouse.
  • Number the pages, and write a watermark on them, in the centre or in any of the nine places of the page.
  • Compress a PDF, and extract its text and pictures.
  • Protect a PDF with a password (AES-256), and choose whether printing, copying and changes are allowed.
  • Clean the information that identifies where a file came from.

Each result is kept for the number of days you set and listed in the journal like any other document.

Save an e-mail as a PDF

  • Drop a saved e-mail (.eml file) and get a PDF with who wrote to whom and when, the text of the message and the list of its attachments, with their size and SHA-256 fingerprint.
  • The original message is kept whole inside the PDF as an attached file. A control reads the PDF produced and checks that this message is identical to the file you gave; the result screen says what was checked and what could not be carried over. A PDF that does not pass the control is not handed over.
  • The pages are laid out in a simple way: they are not a screenshot of your mail program, and the PDF is not a certified copy.
  • When a reply quotes earlier messages, they stay in the body as received. You can also get each one as a PDF of its own, clearly marked as a reconstruction.

A page for your users

  • The plugin creates the page when you activate it. You can rename it, move it in your menu, or put the block, the module or the widget on any other page.
  • You create accounts for your users. They sign in on that page and work there only: they never see your administration or the toolbar of your site.
  • The documents are stored encrypted, in a protected folder, under random names, and handed out only after a check of who is asking: each account sees its own documents only.
  • Limits you can change: size of a document, number of pages, number of days the files are kept.

In your page builder

The block editor, Divi 5 and Elementor each have a VEFdocsKit block, module or widget, with the same choices: the whole page with its tab bar, or only one screen (for example the documents in one page and the journal in another). For each one you can also set the accent color, the text color, the corner radius and the largest width; what you leave empty follows VEFdocsKit > Appearance, then your site. While you edit, the builder shows a stand-in; the page itself appears on your site.

Your configuration, under your control

  • Export the settings to a file and import them on another site; a reset puts back what you tick, after you typed a confirmation word.
  • The privacy tools of WordPress (export and erase personal data) cover the journal, and a text for your privacy policy is suggested.
  • Choose whether deleting the plugin also deletes the journal and the files; by default it keeps them.

Help and support

The Help tab explains how to start, and each tab has the Help button of WordPress. If you ever need help, the Diagnostic and support tab sends your request to the publisher with the technical information already attached, so you have nothing to copy.

VEFdocsKit Pro

A separate, paid extension, VEFdocsKit Pro, works with this plugin and adds:

  • The opening of protected PDF files, including the extracts that come from administrations and company registers.
  • A designer of stamps, with a live preview, and the stamping of documents.
  • Folders with their series of numbers.
  • With the E-mail to PDF tool: each attachment as a numbered file, and each attached e-mail as a PDF of its own with its own checks.
  • A simple electronic signature.
  • The sharing of a folder with collaborators, and the access of visitors to one folder.
  • In “My documents”: the deposit of files awaiting processing, folders and sub-folders, batch selection and a disk quota per user.
  • The full journal, with the folder, the numbers, the SHA-256 fingerprints and an export.

Nothing of the free plugin is locked: the conversion and the twelve tools stay as they are. More on v-images.com.

Other plugins by V-IMAGES

VEFdocsKit is made by V-IMAGES.com (Eric Fabre). VEF stands for V-IMAGES Eric Fabre: it is the common name of this family of plugins. You may also like:

  • VEFmusic: a free plugin for band websites, with an audio player, an album showcase, a show calendar and a press kit. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFpressKit: a downloadable press or media kit (PDF and zip) for any activity. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFmultiBooking: a booking engine for rooms, activities and time slots. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFflipBox: a flip box for Divi 5, the block editor and Elementor. More on v-images.com.

External services

The plugin connects to no external service by itself, and the PDF files never leave your server. The following happens only if you decide it.

  • Optional free license (V-IMAGES, v-images.com, the plugin’s publisher) — only if you ask for it (VEFdocsKit > License): nothing is sent until you fill in the form and tick the consent box. The free license unlocks nothing — the plugin works exactly the same without it; it only lets the publisher send you news and offers, and identify your site when you ask for support. When you register, the following is sent to the V-IMAGES licensing service (REST route /wp-json/vefls/v1/free-license on v-images.com): the email address you typed, the exact consent text you agreed to, your site’s URL, the VEFdocsKit version and your site’s language. You receive an email with a link to confirm your address; once it is confirmed, the service gives your site a discount code on VEFdocsKit Pro, which the License tab shows. While you are registered, each time an administrator opens the License or the Help tab the plugin checks the registration status and the code (on each visit until you confirm by email, then once a week), sending your license key, your site’s URL and the VEFdocsKit version. When you unregister, the plugin asks the service to delete your data.
  • Earlier versions (WordPress.org) — only when an administrator opens the License tab, or clicks the button to go back to an earlier version: the plugin asks api.wordpress.org for the list of the published versions of VEFdocsKit (nothing about your site is sent besides what any request carries, such as the address of the server), and, if you choose a version, downloads its file from downloads.wordpress.org. Nothing else is sent or installed.
  • Support request (optional) — only when a site administrator sends the form of VEFdocsKit > Diagnostic and support. The form sends the e-mail address you typed, the subject and the message, the address of your site, the versions of the plugin, of WordPress and of PHP, and the name and version of the theme, to the publisher’s server at v-images.com. Nothing is sent otherwise.

These services are provided by V-IMAGES (Eric Fabre): Terms of use, Privacy policy.

The links of the About tab and of the help panels only open other websites: nothing is loaded from them until you click.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it. A page of documents is created for you.
  2. Open VEFdocsKit > Accounts and create the accounts of the people who will use the page.
  3. Send them the address of the page. They sign in there and drop their documents.
  4. Optional: open Appearance to change the look of the page, or Settings for the limits and the number of days the files are kept.
  5. Optional: put the VEFdocsKit block, module or widget on another page with the block editor, Divi 5 or Elementor.
sections.faq:
Does it need an external program or an online service?

No. The PDF files are read and written by the plugin itself, in PHP. Documents never leave your server.

Can it open a protected PDF?

Not in this free plugin: a protected file is refused with a message. VEFdocsKit Pro detects the protection by itself, whatever you do with the file, removes the restrictions (editing, copying, printing) of the files that open without a password and tells you with a short message. It asks for the password of the others. Nothing ever guesses or breaks a password.

Where are the documents kept?

In a protected folder of your uploads directory, encrypted, under random names that nobody can guess, for the number of days you choose (Settings, Documents part). They are handed out only to the people allowed to see them. The journal keeps its lines, and the fingerprints recorded with them, after the files are deleted.

Can my users see my administration?

No. The accounts created from the Accounts tab open the page of the documents and nothing else of your site.

Can an account see the documents of another?

No. Each account sees its own documents and its own journal only. By default the administrators see everything, which suits a firm that manages its own users; on a site open to several independent people, untick “Administrators can see the documents and the journal of every account” in the Settings tab.

Does it work with Divi 5, the block editor and Elementor?

Yes. The block editor needs nothing more. The Divi 5 module and the Elementor widget appear only when Divi 5 or Elementor is active. Divi is a product of Elegant Themes and is not included.

Is there a limit to the size of a document?

The plugin has its own limits (25 MB and 400 pages by default, changeable in Settings, Documents part). Your host sets another one for the upload of files: a higher value in the plugin changes nothing until the host raises its own limit.

Do I need a license?

No. The plugin is free and complete. An optional free license is offered in the License tab: it unlocks nothing and changes nothing in the plugin, it only lets the publisher keep in touch with you (news, offers on the other plugins) and answer support requests faster.

What happens to the data when I delete the plugin?

By default nothing is deleted, so that a new installation finds everything again. If you tick “Also delete the journal and the files” in Settings, Documents part, before deleting the plugin, the journal, the files, the settings and the role of the users are removed.

Where is the source code of the compiled script?

The src folder and the build files (package.json, tsconfig.json, webpack.divi.config.js) are included in the plugin. Run npm install then npm run build to rebuild the script of the Divi 5 module (divi5/app/build/app.js). The block editor script (blocks/app/editor.js) is not compiled.
sections.changelog:
0.11.0

  • New: an extension can add its own controls to the bar above the tabs, and ask the page to redraw itself.

0.10.0

  • New: an extension can open a kept document to other people, when its owner chose to share it. Without an extension, a kept document is still read by its owner alone.

0.9.0

  • New: a “Start again” button empties the list and the results of a tool screen, so the next batch of documents starts from nothing, without reloading the page.
  • Fixed: a document keeps the name you gave it. Spaces, accents and capitals are no longer replaced by dashes in the list, the results and the downloads; only the characters a file system forbids are removed.

0.8.8

  • New: the screen that removes the protection of a PDF file can work with or without a password field, so that VEFdocsKit Pro offers one card that opens a file by itself and one that asks for the password.
  • Fixed: the password fields of the documents no longer let the browser fill in a password saved for the site.

0.8.7

  • Fixed: the documents you choose on the home screen are kept when you open a tool with its own screen (such as Stamp), instead of being lost on the way.

0.8.6

  • Fixed: importing settings or data from a file also works on hosts where PHP cannot read back its own temporary folder.

0.8.5

  • Fixed: on hosts where PHP cannot read back its own temporary folder, a file that had arrived was reported as empty. It is now moved into the folder of the plugin as soon as it is received, and a file that cannot be read back is reported as such, with what to ask your host.
  • New: the browser now tells you at once when it cannot read a file you add (for example a file stored in the cloud and not downloaded on your computer, or open in another program), instead of sending it empty.
  • New: the diagnostic report also says whether the received file exists and can be read, and whether open_basedir and upload_tmp_dir are set.

0.8.4

  • New: when a file is refused, the message now says why (the file did not arrive, its size or its first bytes, or the conformity control that failed), and a “Copy the diagnostic report” button copies a short text for the support. The report holds no content of your document and no file name.
  • New: the reason of every refusal is also written in the journal.
  • Changed: an e-mail that fits on one page is now exactly the message, with nothing added; the source name and the page number appear only when the PDF has several pages.
  • Fixed: a file that did not reach the site (too large for the server, or an interrupted transfer) was reported as being of an unsupported type. The message now says that it did not arrive and, for a size limit, what the limit is.
  • Fixed: documents of “My documents” that no tool can open (Word, Excel…) are no longer offered in “Use in a tool”.

0.8.3

  • Changed: the PDF made by the “E-mail to PDF” tool now holds only the message as it was received: its header fields, the list of its attachments and its text. The title, the page of links, the conversion report and the fingerprints of the attachments are no longer added to it. What was checked and what could not be carried over is shown with the result, and the original e-mail is still embedded in the PDF, byte for byte.
  • Changed: the conformity control now reads the whole PDF and refuses it if it holds any text that is not in the message.
  • New: a result with several files (the PDF of an e-mail and its attachments) can be kept in “My documents” in one step.

0.8.2

  • Changed: the “E-mail to PDF” tool no longer prints a page of technical headers (servers, routing, filters). The sender, recipients, date, subject, message identifier, attachments and the text of the message stay in full, and the original e-mail is still embedded in the PDF, byte for byte.
  • Fixed: the conformity control of the “E-mail to PDF” tool could refuse a correct PDF when the e-mail held a very long unbroken word or a signature laid out as a table. The control still refuses any real difference.

0.8.1

  • Fixed: the export and import of the settings now carry the settings of “My documents”, and the reset of the settings puts them back.
  • Fixed: resetting the journal and the finished files also removes what pointed at the kept documents.
  • New: “My documents” has its topic in the Help tab.

0.8.0

  • New: “My documents” tab. A result can be kept in a private, encrypted space, then downloaded, deleted or sent back into any tool. A warning and a confirmation come before keeping it.
  • New: settings for the number of documents, the room per person (MB) and the number of days kept.
  • New: privacy tools (export and erase personal data) and the suggested policy text cover the kept documents.
  • Fixed: the “Too many requests” message and a missing space before “MB” in two French texts.

0.7.0

  • New: AVIF images are accepted. They are read and put in the PDF when the image tools of your server (GD) were built with AVIF.
  • New: when a server cannot read AVIF, the screens say so in plain words, next to the picture concerned, and explain that this depends on the hosting, not on the file. The “Diagnostic” screen has an “AVIF images” check.
  • New: tooltips on most fields, titles and buttons of the settings and tool screens, including the reason why a box or button is greyed out.

0.6.0

  • New: the “E-mail to PDF” tool turns a saved e-mail (.eml) into a PDF with its headers, its text, the list of its attachments and the original message embedded in the PDF. A control checks that the embedded message is identical to the file you gave, and a report on the last page says what was checked. A PDF that does not pass the control is never handed over.
  • New: the earlier messages quoted in a reply can be kept in the body, as received, or also given as PDF files of their own, marked as reconstructions.
  • New: a number can be written in front of the file names, so that the documents of a case stay in order.

0.5.0

  • New: “Convert to PDF” also takes text files (.txt): A4 pages of text, in the font you choose (sans-serif, serif or typewriter).
  • New: the “Protect” tool locks a PDF with a password (AES-256) and lets you choose whether printing, copying and changes are allowed.
  • Fixed: the button of the “Convert to PDF” card read “Remove the protection”; it now reads “Convert to PDF”.

0.4.5

  • New: the size of a picture on its page can be chosen: kept without enlarging (default), fitted to the A4 page, or a page of the size of the picture.

0.4.4

  • New: “Convert to PDF” also takes WebP, GIF and BMP images (an animated GIF gives its first picture).

0.4.3

  • Fixed: the “Convert to PDF” card no longer shows the stamp settings added by VEFdocsKit Pro.
  • New: “Reorder” shows the pages as tiles to drag, or to move with arrows, for a document of up to 60 pages. Typing the page numbers is still possible.
  • New: the watermark can be placed in the centre or in any of the nine places of the page.

0.4.2

  • Tweak: lighter style sheets and fewer database queries on each page of the administration.

0.4.1

  • Tweak: notes for translators on the texts that show a number of pages.

0.4.0

  • New: work on a document with several tools one after the other, without downloading it and sending it again. “Choose from my documents on the site” adds what your earlier work made, and “Use in another tool” on a result sends it to the next tool.

0.3.0

  • New: the “Compress” tool shrinks a PDF at one of five levels, from lossless to smallest. You can try every level and compare, or ask for the largest file size you want, and the plugin picks the lightest level that fits.
  • New: the “Extract text and pictures” tool saves the text of a PDF as a .txt file and its pictures as PNG or JPEG files.
  • Changed: the page of the tools has fewer tabs, with clearer words: Tools, Folders, Sign and Journal. The Documents tab is now the first card of the Tools grid, “Convert to PDF”, so every tool is found in one place.
  • New: the Journal lists everything done with the account. Click a column heading to sort by it, group the lines by day, action or person, and read a new Detail column.
  • New: extension points for the Journal: more sortable columns, more ways to group, and an action wording per line.
  • Changed: in the administration, the Documents tab is gone; the Tools tab holds all the tools.
  • Changed: choosing a tool scrolls to it and puts the focus on it, and the compress and extract screens group their options more clearly.

0.2.14

  • Changed: the administration is organized in five pages: Work, Accounts, Appearance, Settings, and License and help. The Settings page is divided into parts (Page, Access and privacy, Documents, Data). The addresses of the former tabs keep working.
  • New: on the settings forms, a bar at the bottom of the window keeps the Save button in view and tells when a change has not been saved yet.
  • New: a signed-in account that sees nothing else of the site goes straight to the page of the documents when it opens the home page. A box in Settings, Access and privacy turns this off.
  • New: extension points for add-ons: the groups of pages of the administration, the parts of the Settings page, the topics of the Help tab, a mark in the header of every screen, the screen opened first on the page of the documents, and the address an account is sent to from the home page.
  • Changed: the About tab presents V-IMAGES, the online help, the demo and the other plugins from one common list of addresses.
  • Changed: the texts that name a setting give its new place (Appearance, Settings with the name of the part).
  • Changed: the administration no longer uses scripts written in the markup (select on click, confirmation of a form).
  • Fixed: on a small screen, a closed “?” reminder no longer makes the page wider.

0.2.13

  • Added: small “?” reminders next to the fields, titles, buttons and tabs, which explain how each function works. They open on hover, on keyboard focus and on touch. Extensions can add their own.

0.2.12

  • Changed: the About tab is shorter. The list of what the plugin does is in the Guide and in the online help; the About tab links to both, presents V-IMAGES and lists the other plugins.
  • Changed: the License tab no longer carries a link to the page of VEFdocsKit Pro: the invitation stays in the About tab only.
  • Changed: when you unregister and the registration service cannot be reached, the plugin says so instead of saying your data is deleted.
  • Changed: the red status label of an extension (invalid license) has its own look.

0.2.11

  • New: add-ons can add a column to the Accounts tab and a field to the form that creates an account, for example to give each account its own access.
  • Changed: the earliest version offered when you go back to a previous version can be set by an add-on that needs a recent version of the plugin.
  • Changed: the table of the accounts adapts the width of its columns to what it shows.

0.2.10

  • New: a License tab groups the free license, the license of VEFdocsKit Pro and the versions of the plugin.
  • New: once your address is confirmed, the free license shows your discount code on VEFdocsKit Pro in the License tab, with its conditions.
  • New: if an update does not suit you, you can go back to an earlier version published on WordPress.org from the License tab (your documents and settings are kept).
  • Changed: a discreet mention of VEFdocsKit Pro in the plugin and its plugins list. Nothing is locked and nothing changes in the tools.

0.2.9

  • New: three extension points for add-ons that limit the use of the tools (a plan, a quota): the largest size of a file can be set for each person, and an add-on can refuse a batch before any file is read and hear how it ended. Without such an add-on nothing changes.

0.2.8

  • Changed: the code follows the recommendations of the WordPress.org plugin check (hooks shared with the other V-IMAGES plugins). No change of behavior.

0.2.7

  • Changed: the readme links to the live demo and has refreshed search tags. The plugin header links to the plugin page on v-images.com. No change of behavior.

0.2.6

  • Changed: the plugin is now simply named VEFdocsKit.
  • Changed: the icons of the About screen are Dashicons, and the status marks of the Accounts and Diagnostic screens are plain text signs.
  • Changed: the readme describes the journal exactly. The SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded with each line; showing them in the journal and exporting it is part of VEFdocsKit Pro. Screenshots were added.

0.2.5

  • New: an extension can add a tool to the grid of the Tools screen. VEFdocsKit Pro uses it to show the stamp among the other tools.
  • Changed: the page of the documents stays hidden from search engines. Only a page that the webmaster opens to everyone with VEFdocsKit Pro can now be listed, and only for visitors who are not signed in.

0.2.4

  • New: when a protected PDF file is opened and its protection is removed on its own (VEFdocsKit Pro), a short message now says so. It appears in the Documents screen, before stamping, and in each tool, including when files are merged. A protected file is still refused with a clear message when the extension is not installed.

0.2.3

  • Fixed: with a retention of 0 days, the returned documents are now deleted as soon as they have been downloaded, as the Settings tab says. A document that is never downloaded is deleted after one day. Before, a retention of 0 kept the files for ever; the files that were kept this way are deleted too.

0.2.2

  • Changed: the returned documents are stored encrypted, and the Diagnostic tab checks with a real request whether the server refuses direct access to the storage folder.
  • Changed: the names of the uploaded files are cleaned as soon as they are received.
  • Changed: the optional support access is no longer part of this plugin; the Diagnostic and support tab keeps the support request form.

0.2.1

  • Fixed: the description of the image conversion is now exact. Each image is fitted and centered on an A4 page with a 10 mm margin.

0.2.0

  • Changed: opening protected PDF files is now a feature of VEFdocsKit Pro. This free plugin reads the files that are not protected and refuses a protected one with a clear message. Install VEFdocsKit Pro 0.3.0 or later to keep unlocking.
  • New: a setting, “Administrators can see the documents and the journal of every account”, in the Settings tab. Turn it off on a site open to several independent people.
  • New: a setting, “Delete the returned documents of a person as soon as they sign out” (Settings tab). The page tells the person before and after.
  • New: the settings of the tools (last tool and options) are kept with the account instead of the browser, so they follow the person and survive a sign-out.
  • New: extensions can add a line under the sign-in form.
  • New: when a site opens the page to visitors without account, they can try the nine tools on three invented sample documents, without sending anything. The files are the only ones used. Extensions can replace them.
  • Security: the temporary support account is explicitly kept away from the documents of the accounts, whatever its rights.
  • Fixed: a refused action returned a server error instead of a plain “not allowed” answer.

0.1.3

  • Changed: internal clean-up for the WordPress.org code checks. Nothing changes in how the plugin works.

0.1.2

  • New: the stamp engine draws round stamps (two rings, a text along each arc, free lines in the middle). They are made in the stamp designer of VEFdocsKit Pro.

0.1.1

  • New: an optional free license, in Help > About. It unlocks nothing and changes nothing in the plugin: it lets you stay in touch with the publisher (news, offers on the other plugins) and have your support requests recognised faster. Nothing is sent until you fill in the form and tick the consent box; you can unregister at any time, which deletes your data.
  • New: the diagnostic shows the state of the free license (the key partly hidden).

0.1.0

  • First release.

My documents

  • Every result can be kept in “My documents”: a private space, encrypted like the rest, where each account finds its documents again, downloads them, deletes them, or sends them back into any tool without downloading and uploading again.
  • A warning and a confirmation come before keeping a document, so nobody keeps one by mistake. The limits are yours: number of documents, room per person and number of days (Settings).
  • VEFdocsKit Pro adds the deposit of files waiting to be processed, folders inside folders, the choice of several documents at once and a disk quota per person. If the license of the Pro ends, the simple list stays: documents can still be downloaded, used and deleted.

Turn images and text into PDF

  • JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF and BMP images become PDF pages, one image per page, centered on an A4 page. You choose whether a picture is kept at its size, fitted to the page or given a page of its own size.
  • Text files (.txt) become A4 pages of text, in the font you choose: sans-serif, serif or typewriter (every character the same width, so columns stay aligned).

Twelve tools for the pages

  • Merge several documents into one, with an index of the documents in front, a separator page before each one and bookmarks.
  • Split a document by groups of pages or every few pages.
  • Keep, delete or reorder pages, and rotate them. Pages are typed like 1-3, 5, 8- (8- means page 8 to the end). To reorder, you can also drag the pages with the mouse.
  • Number the pages, and write a watermark on them, in the centre or in any of the nine places of the page.
  • Compress a PDF, and extract its text and pictures.
  • Protect a PDF with a password (AES-256), and choose whether printing, copying and changes are allowed.
  • Clean the information that identifies where a file came from.

Each result is kept for the number of days you set and listed in the journal like any other document.

Save an e-mail as a PDF

  • Drop a saved e-mail (.eml file) and get a PDF with who wrote to whom and when, the text of the message and the list of its attachments, with their size and SHA-256 fingerprint.
  • The original message is kept whole inside the PDF as an attached file. A control reads the PDF produced and checks that this message is identical to the file you gave; the result screen says what was checked and what could not be carried over. A PDF that does not pass the control is not handed over.
  • The pages are laid out in a simple way: they are not a screenshot of your mail program, and the PDF is not a certified copy.
  • When a reply quotes earlier messages, they stay in the body as received. You can also get each one as a PDF of its own, clearly marked as a reconstruction.

A page for your users

  • The plugin creates the page when you activate it. You can rename it, move it in your menu, or put the block, the module or the widget on any other page.
  • You create accounts for your users. They sign in on that page and work there only: they never see your administration or the toolbar of your site.
  • The documents are stored encrypted, in a protected folder, under random names, and handed out only after a check of who is asking: each account sees its own documents only.
  • Limits you can change: size of a document, number of pages, number of days the files are kept.

In your page builder

The block editor, Divi 5 and Elementor each have a VEFdocsKit block, module or widget, with the same choices: the whole page with its tab bar, or only one screen (for example the documents in one page and the journal in another). For each one you can also set the accent color, the text color, the corner radius and the largest width; what you leave empty follows VEFdocsKit > Appearance, then your site. While you edit, the builder shows a stand-in; the page itself appears on your site.

Your configuration, under your control

  • Export the settings to a file and import them on another site; a reset puts back what you tick, after you typed a confirmation word.
  • The privacy tools of WordPress (export and erase personal data) cover the journal, and a text for your privacy policy is suggested.
  • Choose whether deleting the plugin also deletes the journal and the files; by default it keeps them.

Help and support

The Help tab explains how to start, and each tab has the Help button of WordPress. If you ever need help, the Diagnostic and support tab sends your request to the publisher with the technical information already attached, so you have nothing to copy.

VEFdocsKit Pro

A separate, paid extension, VEFdocsKit Pro, works with this plugin and adds:

  • The opening of protected PDF files, including the extracts that come from administrations and company registers.
  • A designer of stamps, with a live preview, and the stamping of documents.
  • Folders with their series of numbers.
  • With the E-mail to PDF tool: each attachment as a numbered file, and each attached e-mail as a PDF of its own with its own checks.
  • A simple electronic signature.
  • The sharing of a folder with collaborators, and the access of visitors to one folder.
  • In “My documents”: the deposit of files awaiting processing, folders and sub-folders, batch selection and a disk quota per user.
  • The full journal, with the folder, the numbers, the SHA-256 fingerprints and an export.

Nothing of the free plugin is locked: the conversion and the twelve tools stay as they are. More on v-images.com.

Other plugins by V-IMAGES

VEFdocsKit is made by V-IMAGES.com (Eric Fabre). VEF stands for V-IMAGES Eric Fabre: it is the common name of this family of plugins. You may also like:

  • VEFmusic: a free plugin for band websites, with an audio player, an album showcase, a show calendar and a press kit. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFpressKit: a downloadable press or media kit (PDF and zip) for any activity. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFmultiBooking: a booking engine for rooms, activities and time slots. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFflipBox: a flip box for Divi 5, the block editor and Elementor. More on v-images.com.

External services

The plugin connects to no external service by itself, and the PDF files never leave your server. The following happens only if you decide it.

  • Optional free license (V-IMAGES, v-images.com, the plugin’s publisher) — only if you ask for it (VEFdocsKit > License): nothing is sent until you fill in the form and tick the consent box. The free license unlocks nothing — the plugin works exactly the same without it; it only lets the publisher send you news and offers, and identify your site when you ask for support. When you register, the following is sent to the V-IMAGES licensing service (REST route /wp-json/vefls/v1/free-license on v-images.com): the email address you typed, the exact consent text you agreed to, your site’s URL, the VEFdocsKit version and your site’s language. You receive an email with a link to confirm your address; once it is confirmed, the service gives your site a discount code on VEFdocsKit Pro, which the License tab shows. While you are registered, each time an administrator opens the License or the Help tab the plugin checks the registration status and the code (on each visit until you confirm by email, then once a week), sending your license key, your site’s URL and the VEFdocsKit version. When you unregister, the plugin asks the service to delete your data.
  • Earlier versions (WordPress.org) — only when an administrator opens the License tab, or clicks the button to go back to an earlier version: the plugin asks api.wordpress.org for the list of the published versions of VEFdocsKit (nothing about your site is sent besides what any request carries, such as the address of the server), and, if you choose a version, downloads its file from downloads.wordpress.org. Nothing else is sent or installed.
  • Support request (optional) — only when a site administrator sends the form of VEFdocsKit > Diagnostic and support. The form sends the e-mail address you typed, the subject and the message, the address of your site, the versions of the plugin, of WordPress and of PHP, and the name and version of the theme, to the publisher’s server at v-images.com. Nothing is sent otherwise.

These services are provided by V-IMAGES (Eric Fabre): Terms of use, Privacy policy.

The links of the About tab and of the help panels only open other websites: nothing is loaded from them until you click.
